cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: Although it's tough, it can't handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.description: It's well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.description: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.description: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.description: Some theories suggest that its behavior of forcefully bashing its head into things stimulates cells that affect its evolution.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.description: Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.description: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart's desire—wings.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.description: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.description: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.description: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

cards.name: Flapple
cards.description: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

cards.name: Appletun
cards.description: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

cards.name: Regidrago
cards.description: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.description: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.description: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.description: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.description: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.description: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.description: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it's intelligent, obedient to its Trainer's commands, and easy to raise.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.description: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.description: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.description: A combative Pokémon, it's ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.description: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it's Corviknight that's taken the role of transportation in Galar.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.description: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.description: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

cards.name: Gossifleur
cards.description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

cards.name: Rapid Strike Scroll of the Flying Dragon
Single Strike Scroll of the Fanged Dragon
Eldegoss
cards.description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

cards.name: Applin
cards.description: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.description: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.description: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.description: It spits out cold air of nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.

cards.name: Inteleon
cards.description: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.description: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.description: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: It has been found that its brain cells are 10 times more active when Psyduck is experiencing a headache.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: A professional swimmer, it can continue swimming for two days straight by waving its long tail skillfully.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.description: Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1% contains the organ that makes its poison.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.description: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it's a warning sign.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.description: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.description: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.description: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.description: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.description: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.description: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.description: It's said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you're feeling.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.description: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.description: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.description: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.description: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Bergmite
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in areas of frigid cold. It secures itself to the back of an Avalugg by freezing its feet in place.

cards.name: Avalugg
cards.description: As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon's body returns to a pristine state overnight.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.description: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

cards.name: Eiscue
cards.description: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.description: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

cards.name: Regieleki
cards.description: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.description: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

cards.name: Galarian Articuno
cards.description: Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires beams that can immobilize opponents as if they had been frozen solid.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.description: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.description: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.description: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

cards.name: Floette
cards.description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

cards.name: Florges
cards.description: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo
cards.description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

cards.name: Gourgeist
cards.description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.description: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

cards.name: Ribombee
cards.description: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.description: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Galarian Zapdos
cards.description: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.description: This Pokémon is active during the day and passes the cold desert nights burrowed snugly into the sand.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.description: When roused to violence by its rage, it spews out the quantities of sand it has swallowed and whips up a sandstorm.

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.description: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

cards.name: Boldore
cards.description: It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it's facing.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.description: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.description: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.description: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.description: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

cards.name: Galarian Moltres
cards.description: The sinister aura that blazes like molten fire around this Pokémon is what inspired the name Moltres.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.description: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.description: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.description: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.
